name: Jarvis Event Logger

nodes.name: HA Event Webhook
nodes.notes: POST /webhook/jarvis-event with body {event, entity, from, to, ts}. Trigger from an HA automation via rest_command.jarvis_event.

nodes.name: Append to Event Log (Local REST API)
nodes.notes: POST /vault/Claude Memory/Projects/Smart Home/event_log.md APPENDS the row via desktop Obsidian on the PC; Obsidian Sync then delivers the updated event_log.md to all devices. allowUnauthorizedCerts=true for the plugin's self-signed cert on :27124 (or use http://PC:27123). Requires desktop Obsidian running with the Local REST API plugin. NOT git. Fallback: wire a Filesystem node on the error output for when the PC/Obsidian is off.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, logged: $('Format Event Row').item.json.row }) }}

main.node: Append to Event Log (Local REST API)

_jarvis_import_notes: Import via n8n: Workflows -> ... -> Import from File. Then set env vars OBSIDIAN_REST_URL (e.g. https://PC-IP:27124) and OBSIDIAN_REST_TOKEN (Settings -> Variables, or .env if self-hosting). The event logger appends a markdown row to 'Claude Memory/Projects/Smart Home/event_log.md' through the Obsidian Local REST API plugin running in desktop Obsidian on the PC (NOT git) — Obsidian Sync then delivers the updated file to all devices. Install + enable the plugin before importing. Node versions verified against current n8n via the n8n MCP get_node_types: webhook 2.1, code 2 (mode runOnceForAllItems), httpRequest 4.4, respondToWebhook 1.5. The raw-body append uses contentType 'raw' + specifyBody 'string' + rawContentType 'text/markdown' (n8n's raw-body shape). Trigger it from an HA automation calling rest_command.jarvis_event with {event, entity, from, to, ts}. Add a Filesystem-node fallback on the append node's error output for when the PC/Obsidian is off.
